pages.text:
Complaint to Cyber Bureau, Nepal Police
श्रीमान् प्रमुख ज्यू,
साइबर ब्यूरो, नेपाल प्रहरी, काठमाडौं।
विषय: अनलाइन ठगी सम्बन्धमा उजुरी।
I, Sunita Rai (+9779841002233), received an SMS on 2026-07-14
claiming I had won NPR 15,000 in an eSewa Dashain cashback draw.
I was directed to https://esewa-bonus-claim.xyz/verify?ref=DSN2026 and asked to pay
a service fee of NPR 500 to eSewa ID 9812345678. I paid this amount
(transaction ESW-2026-0714-88231). I was then asked for a further NPR 12,000 to the bank
account 01903015472901, which I also paid.
The contact number used was +9779812345678 and the email address was
reward.center2026@gmail.com. No cashback was ever received.
I request investigation and recovery of NPR 12,500.
